title: Knead Butter Crumble
description: A buttery, crunchy Indian dish featuring capers and sugar-free-friendly, perfect for a crowd-pleaser snack or dessert.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine butter with almond flour until well combined.
Add chopped capers and optional honey to the mixture.
Shape the mixture into small crumble pieces using your hands or a rolling pin for even distribution of ingredients.
Place crumbles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, until golden brown and crunchy.
Allow to cool slightly before serving.
